title: Isolated Stutzerimonas frequens E49
description: This project demonstrated that isolated Stutzerimonas frequence E49, a denitrifying bacterium, has the potential to consume nitrous oxide, a greenhouse gas with a global warming potential 260 times greater than that of carbon dioxide.  These findings advance our fundamental understanding of strategies to mitigate global warming.
center: Terada and Riya Laboratory Chemical engineering Department of Technology, Tokyo university of Agriculture and Technology
samples: Stutzerimonas frequens E49 isolated from activated sludge treating landfil leachate
